content.title: U Power inaugurates smart battery-swapping station in Thailand
content.summary: The inauguration of the Thailand station comes after U Power's delivery of the first battery-swapping compatible taxi fleet this May.

thumbnail.caption: The Thailand station is said to integrate U Power's UOTTA technology to improve the transmission of data and station control logic. Credit: U Power Limited/PRNewswire.

content.title: U Power Launches First Smart Battery Swapping Station in Southeast Asia
content.summary: U Power has inaugurated Southeast Asia's first smart battery-swapping station in Phuket, Thailand, designed for electric taxis and ride-hailing fleets.

content.title: A small Chinese startup wants to jumpstart a global EV taxi revolution
content.summary: U Power’s battery swap model aims to electrify Hong Kong’s taxis—and reshape commercial EV adoption worldwide

thumbnail.caption: Hong Kong's taxi fleet is notoriously antiquated. U Power hopes its battery-swapping tech will help the city's old-fashioned taxi drivers embrace EVs.

content.title: U Power, SAIC Motor-CP partner to advance EV battery-swapping in Thailand
content.summary: The firms will develop a network of swapping stations and operating systems, with initial focus on taxi and ride-hailing sectors.

thumbnail.caption: U Power will modify its battery-swapping technology to accommodate the Thai MG brand vehicles. Credit: Darunrat Wongsuvan/Shutterstock.

content.title: U Power unveils autonomous battery swapping logistics vehicles
content.summary: The company has tested vehicles that integrate AI-driven autonomous driving technology with UOTTA's battery-swapping system.

thumbnail.caption: This innovation allows for the complete automation of electric vehicle battery swap stations and unmanned energy replenishment. Credit: U Power limited/ PRNewswire.
